name: Exterior Trim Repaint Cleanup
intent: Final inspection, touchup (defects + transitions), protection teardown (SF-based), scaffold teardown, equipment cleanup, waste disposal, customer walkthrough.
doctrine: Repaint cleanup includes transition touchup (trim-to-wall lines) which NC doesn't have. Customer walkthrough is RP-specific — customer expects to see the work. Protection teardown at 1000 SF/hr. Final inspection at 400 LF/hr (matches NC).
